title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authorization Information Disclosure Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126968)
description: CVE-2026-126968 is an information disclosure vulnerability in SmarterTools SmarterMail affecting the handling of email attachments. It allows remote authenticated attackers to access sensitive information due to missing authorization checks prior to accessing certain functionality. The vulnerability requires valid authentication to exploit and does not impact system integrity or availability.
